title: Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments
title_zh: Terminal-Universe：将智能体轨迹转化为可扩展的终端环境
abstract_en: As terminal-based code agents become prevalent, agent trajectories have accumulated at scale, while realistic, executable environments remain scarce. However, environments are what agent post-training actually requires: each can be re-queried into many verifiable tasks and provides execution feedback, whereas a trajectory is a single frozen demonstration. Rather than generating environments from scratch, we observe that the tool-execution history in existing trajectories exposes the structure and contents of the environments in which they ran, making it possible to reconstruct those environments from the trajectories themselves. Thus, we introduce Terminal-Universe, a framework which turns each trajectory into a reusable environment and explores it for synthesizing new tasks and continued interactions. Specifically, Terminal-Universe replays the file operations recorded in a trajectory to restore each file before the agent modified it, yielding a partial workspace; a completion agent then supplies the missing files and dependencies. On this recovered workspace, we both reconstruct the original intent task and synthesize entirely new ones. Besides, we also scale the tasks along two complementary axes: breadth and depth. For breadth, we mine directional dependency relations between related environments and synthesize cross-workspace queries spanning multiple codebases, as developers routinely do in real-world development. For depth, we extend the initial single-turn query into a multi-round session that captures iterative user feedback and requirement refinement via a user agent. Applied to public terminal agent trajectories, Terminal-Universe produces 37.3k task-sufficient environments. Supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-27B on this corpus improves single-round performance on Terminal-Bench 2.1 by 11.9 points and multi-round performance on EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4 by 13.8 points.
abstract_zh: 随着基于终端的代码智能体普及，大规模智能体轨迹不断积累，但真实、可执行的环境仍然稀缺。论文指出，环境比单次冻结的轨迹更适合智能体后训练：环境可被反复查询以生成多个可验证任务，并提供执行反馈。Terminal-Universe 不从零生成环境，而是利用已有轨迹中的工具执行历史重建其运行环境。具体而言，方法回放轨迹记录的文件操作，在智能体修改前恢复各文件，得到部分工作区，再由 completion agent 补全缺失文件与依赖。在恢复后的工作区上，框架既重建原始意图任务，也合成全新任务；同时从广度和深度两个维度扩展任务。广度方面，挖掘相关环境之间的方向性依赖关系，生成跨多个代码库的查询；深度方面，通过 user agent 将单轮请求扩展为包含用户反馈和需求细化的多轮交互。应用于公开终端智能体轨迹后，Terminal-Universe 生成了 37.3k 个任务完备环境。基于该语料对 Qwen3.5-27B 进行监督微调后，Terminal-Bench 2.1 单轮性能提升 11.9 个百分点，EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4 多轮性能提升 13.8 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 核心思想是将单次智能体轨迹转化为可复用、可执行、可反复探索的终端环境。
通过回放文件操作恢复部分工作区，再由 completion agent 补全缺失文件和依赖，降低环境构建成本。
在恢复环境中同时重建原始任务并合成新任务，并沿广度与深度扩展：生成跨代码库任务和多轮交互任务。
从公开轨迹中构建了 37.3k 个任务完备环境，体现出较强的规模化数据构造能力。
使用该语料微调 Qwen3.5-27B 后，Terminal-Bench 2.1 单轮性能提升 11.9 个百分点，EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4 多轮性能提升 13.8 个百分点。

llm_assessment.comment: Exceptional coding-agent infrastructure that converts trajectories into executable, scalable environments for task synthesis, interaction, and post-training.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这项工作将编码智能体轨迹转化为可执行且可扩展的环境，用于任务合成、交互和后训练，基础价值非常高。
